title: I Shall Walk in My Integrity

questions.question: Vindicate me, O Lord, for I have walked in my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 26:1 (ESV): "Vindicate me, O Lord, for I have walked in my integrity,"

questions.question: I have trusted in the Lord without what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 26:1 (ESV): "...and I have trusted in the Lord without wavering."

questions.question: Prove me, O Lord, and try me; test my heart and my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 26:2 (ESV): "Prove me, O Lord, and try me; test my heart and my mind."

questions.question: For your steadfast love is before my eyes, and I walk in your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 26:3 (ESV): "For your steadfast love is before my eyes, and I walk in your faithfulness."

questions.question: I do not sit with men of falsehood, nor do I consort with whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 26:4 (ESV): "I do not sit with men of falsehood, nor do I consort with hypocrites."

questions.question: I hate the assembly of evildoers, and I will not sit with the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 26:5 (ESV): "I hate the assembly of evildoers, and I will not sit with the wicked."

questions.question: I wash my hands in innocence and go around your what, O Lord?
questions.explanation: Psalm 26:6 (ESV): "I wash my hands in innocence and go around your altar, O Lord,"

questions.question: Proclaiming thanksgiving aloud, and telling all your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 26:7 (ESV): "proclaiming thanksgiving aloud, and telling all your wondrous deeds."

questions.question: O Lord, I love the habitation of your house and the place where your what dwells?
questions.explanation: Psalm 26:8 (ESV): "O Lord, I love the habitation of your house and the place where your glory dwells."

questions.question: Do not sweep my soul away with sinners, nor my life with what kind of men?
questions.explanation: Psalm 26:9 (ESV): "Do not sweep my soul away with sinners, nor my life with bloodthirsty men,"

questions.question: In whose hands are evil devices, and whose right hands are full of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 26:10 (ESV): "in whose hands are evil devices, and whose right hands are full of bribes."

questions.question: But as for me, I shall walk in my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 26:11 (ESV): "But as for me, I shall walk in my integrity; redeem me, and be gracious to me."

questions.question: My foot stands on level ground; in the great assembly I will bless whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 26:12 (ESV): "My foot stands on level ground; in the great assembly I will bless the Lord."

questions.question: Redeem me, and be gracious to whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 26:11 (ESV): "...redeem me, and be gracious to me."

questions.question: Who is the author of Psalm 26?

key_verse_text: Vindicate me, O Lord, for I have walked in my integrity, and I have trusted in the Lord without wavering.
